scope: Partial M02-F04 M09-F02 M10-F01/F02 market evidence and account research review

browserChecks: Actual owner permission form records an explicit internal-use declaration without creating a key
Actual preview validates sources and current permissions without persisting observations
Changed batch inputs fence the previous preview
Reviewed owner intake records one canonical account observation without contact authority
Existing batch preview shows an immutable receipt and disables repeated recording
Actual HTTP source endpoint authenticates a correction and deduplicates its receipt replay
Existing strategy and operating review display minimized current source evidence
Competing permission changes preserve the stale draft and reject overwrite
New permission versions mask older reports until a new explicitly bound source revision
Actual owner retirement remains terminal across new authenticated source batches
Retired historical receipts preserve revisions while masking source fields
Desktop/mobile research interface fits without overflow or browser errors
Research intake and retirement create no recruiting queue task or external contact

apiChecks: Owner market permission, overview and receipt APIs load without exposing source key hashes
Anonymous market reads, permission changes, previews, records and retirement denied
Deployed source HTTP endpoint rejects unsigned and invalid bearer requests without writing observations
Private market responses enforce no-store and no-referrer headers
Filtered market display retains full aggregate evidence semantics
Existing strategy and daily brief settings remain unchanged; only minimized nonfinancial market context is joined
Read-only and rejected-request acceptance creates no new market receipt or permission
browserChecks: Actual owner research page, summary, declarations and receipts render
Source key management reuses the canonical Intake page
Unconfigured source prerequisites are shown without inventing a provider or key
Observation-kind filters refresh the deployed protected overview
Unreviewed batches cannot be recorded through the owner interface
Desktop and mobile interface fit without horizontal overflow
Existing strategy and operating brief expose the separate source-evidence view
Browser acceptance performs no successful or attempted owner mutation and has no runtime/transport errors

limits: Genuine licensed-provider and external authenticity/rights acceptance
Real discovery/contact enrichment and independent lead/payment-risk qualification
Non-employer-linked regional benchmarks and calibrated forecasts
Delegated autonomous acquisition objectives and complete advanced modules
